determinism.protocol: second render in a fresh subprocess, byte-compare

event_to_block_policy: events.txt positions are absolute sample offsets; the oracle applies every event before the 64-sample block containing its position (oracle main.cpp render loop)
fidelity_note: Oracle agreement is software-reference agreement only; it is not original-DX7 fidelity and never implies the instrument sounds good (reference/oracle-protocol.md section 4, DEC-001).

oracle_identity.event_to_block_policy: events.txt positions are absolute sample offsets; the oracle applies every event before the 64-sample block containing its position (oracle main.cpp render loop)
oracle_identity.fidelity_note: Oracle agreement is software-reference agreement only; it is not original-DX7 fidelity and never implies the instrument sounds good (reference/oracle-protocol.md section 4, DEC-001).
oracle_identity.purpose: Pin the external GPL render oracle consumed by tools/render_reference.py, so every render is attributable to one exact binary built from one exact source tree. The oracle itself is NOT committed here and must never be rebuilt from this repository.

source.role: external-oracle-only; never copied into this Apache-2.0 repository (AGENTS.md licensing/source policy; docs/REUSE-RULINGS.md)

trace_extension.non_invasiveness: wrapper-level reads only; traced and untraced PCM verified byte-identical by tools/capture_trace.py before any trace artifact is written
trace_extension.unavailable_taps: per-operator phase, envelope stage/level, feedback history, per-operator output live inside the Dexed msfa engine and are documented-unavailable (reference/trace-registry.json)

oracle_identity.usage: dx7-oracle --voice voice.syx --events events.txt --out out.f32 [--meta meta.json] [--trace trace.jsonl] [--rate 48000] [--seconds 4]

wav_convenience_copy.conversion: clamp to [-1,1], scale by 32767, round-half-to-even, saturate to int16
wav_convenience_copy.format: WAVE_FORMAT_PCM, 16-bit integer, mono (stdlib wave cannot write IEEE float; render.f32 is the exact evidence of record)
